prompt: Both hall cards were printed before nine. A replacement printer is not ready. What should the volunteer do with the cards in the meantime?
promptZh: 兩張展卡都已在九點前印出，替換用的印表機還不能使用。這段期間志工該怎麼處理展卡？

options.text: Add Tessa’s name; leave Lin’s visible.
options.zh: 加上泰莎的名字；琳的名字維持可見。
options.whyZh: 泰莎沒有親自提出書面要求，不能加名；琳已書面撤回署名，應立即遮住姓名。

options.text: Leave 17 unchanged; cover only Lin’s name.
options.zh: 17 號不變；只遮住琳的名字。
options.whyZh: 泰莎未要求修改署名，只有志工留下便條；琳本人已用電郵撤回署名，重印前先遮住姓名，不遮編號和作品名稱。

options.zh: 17 號不變；撤下 42 號的展卡。
options.whyZh: 17 號可以維持原樣；42 號則只遮住姓名，不能因此讓作品名稱和參展編號都不見。

options.text: Hide both names and titles pending confirmation.
options.zh: 兩張展卡的姓名與作品名稱都先遮住，等候確認。
options.whyZh: 17 號本來就不應署名，琳的書面撤回也已確認，兩張展卡的作品名稱都應保留。

explanationZh: 泰莎未要求修改署名，只有志工留下便條；琳本人已用電郵撤回署名，重印前先遮住姓名，不遮編號和作品名稱。
evidence: Change printed hall credit only at the maker's written request. If withdrawn, cover the name but keep the title and number visible until the new card is ready. / No hall name credit. / Lin emailed at nine to remove her printed hall credit. At nine fifteen a volunteer asked to add Tessa's name; Tessa herself has not requested this.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Change printed hall credit only at the maker's written request. If withdrawn, cover the name but keep the title and number visible until the new card is ready.
Lin emailed at nine to remove her printed hall credit. At nine fifteen a volunteer asked to add Tessa's name; Tessa herself has not requested this.

vocabulary.note: 此處指收回在展卡上公開姓名的同意。
